name: Carbon Dating makes each Sands of Time stack raise Epoch's healing by 10% (#545)
contract: Carbon Dating 706102 is a passive whose only effect is SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER (107) with EffectMiscValue 23 = SPELLMOD_EFFECT3 and EffectBasePoints 9, resolving to 10 with DieSides 1. Its EffectSpellClassMask [16384,0,0] selects exactly one SpellFamilyName 28 spell: Sands of Time 804488 (SpellFamilyFlags [16384,0,0]). Sands of Time effect 2 is SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER (108) with EffectMiscValue 0 = SPELLMOD_DAMAGE and EffectSpellClassMask [4,0,0], which is Epoch (SpellFamilyFlags [4,0,0]); its EffectBasePoints -1 resolves to 0, so untalented the modifier is worth nothing. SPELLMOD_EFFECT3 is folded into that effect's value by Unit::ApplyEffectModifiers through SpellEffectInfo::CalcValue, and AuraEffect::CalculateAmount then multiplies the result by the stack amount (SpellAuraEffects.cpp), which is what the tooltip's 'each stack' means. The module forces Sands of Time's StackAmount to 5 (AscensionChronomancerTime.cpp ApplyTimeContracts). Unit::SpellHealingBonusDone applies SPELLMOD_DAMAGE to heals, and Sands of Time carries AttributesEx3 0x0, so SPELL_ATTR3_IGNORE_CASTER_MODIFIERS does not block it. Native handlers only: no spell_proc, spell_script_names or module script is involved. Regression scenario for behaviour that already works.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Carbon Dating self-applies its passive aura once learned
Sands of Time carries no SPELLMOD_EFFECT3 bonus without the talent
Carbon Dating adds 10 to Sands of Time's third effect
Fixture five Sands of Time stacks on the control
Fixture five Sands of Time stacks on the talented Chronomancer
Untalented, Sands of Time's Epoch damage modifier stays at zero
With the talent, five stacks resolve to a 50% Epoch modifier
Baseline Epoch healing at five stacks without the talent
Epoch heals 50% harder at five stacks with the talent
